== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A Forger is a type of [[sacred artist]] who specializes in the manipulation and shaping of [[madra]] into physical or illusory forms. This discipline is considered one of the four fundamental skills required to become a complete [[sacred artist]], and practitioners often use hammer-shaped badges to signify their expertise. [[Forging]] is a foundational skill for [[Soulsmiths]], who use it to create functional shells around [[binding|bindings]] or to manipulate [[dead matter]]. While some Forgers focus on creating tangible [[constructs]]—such as weapons, shields, or even complex tools like drudges—others specialize in the creation of illusions. One prominent application of [[Forging]] is found on the [[Path of the White Fox]], where practitioners utilize the [[Fox Mirror technique]]. This method allows them to craft highly detailed deceptions made of light and [[dreams]], such as false walls, duplicate people, or camouflaged environments. While these illusions can appear indistinguishable from reality, they lack physical substance and are easily destroyed by attacks. Advanced Forgers may be able to imbue their creations with a semblance of life or produce multiple copies of an object, such as a single weapon appearing as several simultaneous strikes. The complexity and stability of a [[Forged]] object often depend on the artist's skill, as many techniques are temporary and dissipate after a short period.}}
